correctness.rationale: All spaces are complex projective normal surfaces with the explicit smooth blow-up resolution [1]. Contractions are disjoint rational trees with classes A=E_j-E_{j+1} at undisplayed Jordan sizes and, for a regular pencil, H-sum E. The generated exceptional lattice is primitive: path-edge differences have torsion-free quotient, and H-sum E has unit H coefficient. The integral Leray restriction map is therefore surjective, giving H^3=0 and H^2 equal to the literal integer perpendicular lattice. The displayed integral bases give Gram matrices diag(1,-d) and dd^T-diag(d), with exact determinant. H^0/H^4 are Z; H^1 and higher odd vanish. The executable finite checks support but do not prove the infinite assertion.

value.rationale: The claim is a complete integral cup-product ring classification for a natural class of singular projective surfaces arising from matrix pencils. Rational numerical intersection data cannot resolve integral lattice indices or torsion. The uniform formulas prove their absence, calculate discriminants and identify exactly which Kronecker features are invisible to this invariant, giving structural information beyond any finite census. The theorem remains useful without an additional general classification theorem.
